subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:12:00Z
Subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria & kickoff plan

Hi Marissa / Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — useful conversation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can lock the POC timeline: 

Scope (agreed on call):
- Validate Redwood inference for our transaction-class workload (avg request size ~600 tokens)
- Measure latency and cost per 1M tokens for the production-ish trace we shared
- Verify secure data handling and audit logs

Proposed success criteria (high level):
1) 95th percentile latency < 400ms for 1k concurrent requests (or equivalent TPS you recommend)
2) End-to-end correctness: sample prompt set pass rate >= 92% on key intent classification
3) No PII leakage in model outputs on our test corpus
4) Clear audit logs and access controls enabled

What we need from Redwood to proceed:
- Finalized success criteria + measurable evaluation plan
- POC timeline and owners (we can commit 2 engineers + product lead)
- Any required access/credentials for the dataset and test environment

We'd like to start the POC with a kickoff week of June 8 if possible. Can you send over a short map of tasks and owners? Also please include any lightweight install or connectivity steps so our infra team can prep.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Brown
Head of Integrations | Finlytics
alex.brown@finlytics.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@finlytics.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: success criteria & kickoff plan

Alex — great to meet you today, and thanks for the clear recap. Attached are two quick artifacts: a one-page POC success criteria doc and a draft POC MAP (high-level tasks, owners, and timeline). Please see the attachments and my notes below.

Attachment: POC-success-criteria.docx (2 pages)
Attachment: Finlytics-POC-MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet, task-level)

Proposed success criteria (refined & measurable):
- Performance: 95th percentile generation latency < 400ms for up to 1k concurrent requests (we'll define concurrency vs. TPS in the MAP)
- Quality: baseline eval on your canonical prompt set with >92% pass rate on key intents; we will run weekly regression checks
- Security/Compliance: no PII in outputs on our sampled test corpus; all calls logged with request IDs and user attribution
- Stability: zero unrecoverable service failures during the 2-week trial window (short SLO)

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): environment prep and data access; run smoke tests
- Week 1: full trace replay + baseline metrics; initial tuning (batching/quantization as needed)
- Week 2: final run, pass/fail check against success criteria; export logs and the evaluation report

Owners (Redwood):
- Rafael Mendes — POC technical lead (inference runtime / deployment)
- Sean Gallagher — Customer success (onboarding, weekly syncs)
- Marissa Cole — Sales owner / program manager for the POC

Open questions for Finlytics:
- Who will be the primary data steward for access requests?
- Are there any IP/data-retention constraints we should be aware of for the test traces?

If that looks good I can schedule a 30-min kickoff for June 8 (PT) and share a short mutual action plan. Rafael — can you confirm infra prerequisites (GPU types, network egress rules) so we can share with Alex's infra team?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Alex / Team — quick tech notes and timeline confirmation from our side.

Infra prerequisites (short):
- Preferred: A100 (or equivalent) GPU for the initial baseline runs; we can run smaller tests on T4 but latency won't match production expectations
- VPN/SSH: please allow TLS egress to our private endpoints and open port 443 for the agent; we will provide a signed certificate and temporary credentials for the trial
- Data: a sanitized 24-hour trace should be sufficient for baseline; we recommend 1-2 million tokens for reliable latency/cost estimates

Timeline & kickoff:
- Proposed kickoff: 2026-06-08 10:00 PT (30 min) — Rafael (lead), Sean (CS), Marissa (sales), Alex, Priya, plus your infra engineer
- Week 0 (6/8–6/12): env setup and smoke tests
- Week 1 (6/15–6/19): replay + tuning
- Week 2 (6/22–6/26): final runs and evaluation

Action items assigned: 
- Alex / Priya: confirm data steward and provide sanitized trace by 6/5
- Finlytics infra: whitelist Redwood endpoint and confirm GPU availability by 6/5
- Rafael: share exact endpoint URL and temp creds by 6/4
- Marissa: will schedule kickoff and weekly check-ins

I'll draft the short runbook after Rafael shares the endpoint details.

Best,
Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
